sights.name: Test State Capitol
sights.text: The Test State Capitol was finished in 1888 out of pink granite, and it is a little taller than the one in Washington.

sights.name: Test Moonlight Tower
sights.text: One of the moonlight towers put up in 1894-95 to light the whole city at night.
sights.where: at the corner by the tower

sights.name: Test Old Ferry Landing
sights.text: A ferry crossed the river here before the first bridge.
